report:
test_total does not fail. I ran the tests: test_total and test_plain pass; the one that fails is test_half_cent_rounds_up.

What I ran: python -m pytest test_cart.py -q in the work folder. Result: 1 failed, 2 passed.

Why test_total passes: 399 * (1 - 10/100) = 359.1, and int(359.1) = 359, which is what the test expects.

Why test_half_cent_rounds_up fails: 1010 * (1 - 5/100) = 959.5. cart.total uses int(), which truncates toward zero, so it returns 959. The test expects 959.5 to round up to 960. The docstring says "rounded to whole cents" but the code truncates; that is the mismatch. Note also that Python's round(959.5) gives 960 only because 960 is even (round half to even); round(958.5) would give 958, so a plain round() swap would not match "half cent rounds up" in every case.

I changed nothing. If you want the failing test fixed, say which rounding rule total() should follow (truncate, round half up, or Python's round half to even) and I will build that.
